name: World Tile Foundry
actions: start from a verified sparse 10 kilometre circular metric world without materializing empty cells
choose a bounded world form, dimensions, sectors, loading chunks and playable height
author in a 128 pixels per metre flat canvas or a metre-scale spatial canvas
open independent game builds in separate browser workspaces
inspect a neutral semantic world over its aligned raster
compose reversible layer remaps, feature overrides and additions
export an explicit game-builder handoff without changing the source
export locally authored map work as a Universal Component without relabelling imported assets
summary: Shape a sparse metric world whose untouched cells remain mathematical space while authored changes become portable patches and components.
notes: Blank is the default and authored content is opt-in. Presentation frames are never world truth. Imported or unknown-provenance work is never relabelled self-made. The base source and raster remain immutable; visual approval, game installation and canonical promotion stay explicit.
